Display

Includes only observations most representative of surface water conditions. Records with conductivity ≤200 µS/cm, which often indicate the sensors were not in the water, and dissolved oxygen values ≤0.10 mg/L, which are treated as likely sensor artifacts, are excluded. Leave unchecked to show all data.

Prints the current selections, map, charts, and summary cards.

Advanced filters and QA/QC

DO artifact rule: every dissolved oxygen value at or below 0.10 mg/L is treated as a likely sensor artifact. These records remain available when all data are shown, but are excluded when “Show the most representative surface water data” is checked.
